overview: The 18650 is a standard-sized cylindrical lithium-ion cell (18mm diameter, 65mm length — hence the name) reused from laptop battery packs and flashlights, and this holder gives it spring-loaded contacts and solder tabs so it can be wired into a project without soldering directly to the battery itself. Holders come in single-cell and multi-cell (2/4-cell) versions wired in series or parallel; using multiple cells safely, especially in series, generally calls for a matching BMS to keep the cells balanced and protected — mixing old and new cells or different capacity cells in a series pack is a common way to shorten pack life or create safety issues.
simpleSummary: A little holder that lets you snap in a rechargeable battery (shaped like a fat AA) without any soldering.

specifications.contactType: Spring-loaded button contacts, solder-tab or wire leads
specifications.configurations: Single-cell, or multi-cell holders wired in series/parallel
specifications.cellVoltageNote: The holder itself has no electronics — voltage/protection depends entirely on the cell and any BMS used

pinMap.name: Positive (+)
pinMap.function: Positive terminal, contacting the cell's button end.
pinMap.currentLimit: Depends on the cell's discharge rating
pinMap.gotcha: The holder provides zero protection circuitry — an unprotected cell wired straight to a load has no over-discharge or short-circuit protection at all.

pinMap.name: Negative (-)
pinMap.function: Negative terminal, contacting the cell's flat end.
pinMap.gotcha: Inserting a cell backwards is usually physically prevented by the spring/tab shapes, but always double-check polarity markings before wiring downstream electronics.

useCases.title: Swappable-battery robot power
useCases.scenario: Let a robot's battery be quickly swapped for a charged spare rather than waiting for an onboard recharge.

useCases.title: Multi-cell portable power pack
useCases.scenario: Combine several 18650 cells in series/parallel (with a matching BMS) for higher voltage or capacity.

useCases.title: Flashlight/portable device power
useCases.scenario: The original common use case these cells and holders come from.

oftenConfusedWith: LiPo pouch cells (flexible, different form factor, often already include protection)
oftenUpgradedTo: Pre-assembled protected battery packs for simpler, safer integration
